Class EncLogRecord

java.lang.Object
LogRecord
EncLogRecord
public class EncLogRecord extends LogRecord
Represents an encoded log record. The payload is encrypted using a Caesar cipher. The value field represents the backward shift amount.

  • Method Details

    • decrypt

      private String decrypt()
      Decrypts the payload using a backward Caesar shift. Letters are shifted backward by the value amount. Uppercase and lowercase letters are preserved. Non-letter characters remain unchanged.
      Returns:
      decrypted message

    • processPayload

      public int processPayload()
      Processes the payload. Decrypts the message and stores it. Returns the integer from Utility.process().
